description: This file defines the BlockInfoManager class and related classes/objects for managing block metadata and locks within Apache Spark's storage subsystem. It handles block locking, visibility, and removal, and tracks metadata for individual blocks, including their lock states and ownership.

classes.name: BlockInfo
classes.description: Represents metadata for an individual block, including storage level, size, lock state, and ownership.

classes.name: BlockInfoWrapper
classes.description: Wraps a BlockInfo with a lock and condition for thread-safe access.

classes.name: BlockInfoManager
classes.description: Manages block metadata, locking, visibility, and removal within Spark's storage layer.

methods.name: registerTask
methods.description: Registers a task attempt ID with the BlockInfoManager, initializing lock tracking structures.

methods.name: lockForReading
methods.description: Acquires a read lock on a block for the current task, returning its metadata.

methods.name: lockForWriting
methods.description: Acquires a write lock on a block for the current task, returning its metadata.

methods.name: assertBlockIsLockedForWriting
methods.description: Checks that the current task holds a write lock on the specified block.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves block metadata without locking; used internally.

methods.name: downgradeLock
methods.description: Converts a write lock to a read lock for a block.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Releases a lock held on a block by the current task.

methods.name: lockNewBlockForWriting
methods.description: Attempts to create and lock a new block for writing, enforcing first-writer-wins.

methods.name: releaseAllLocksForTask
methods.description: Releases all locks held by a given task, cleaning up metadata.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of blocks tracked.

methods.name: getNumberOfMapEntries
methods.description: Returns the total number of internal map entries, used for testing/memory leak detection.

methods.name: entries
methods.description: Returns an iterator over all tracked block metadata.

methods.name: rddBlockIds
methods.description: Returns all block IDs associated with a specific RDD.

methods.name: broadcastBlockIds
methods.description: Returns all block IDs associated with a specific broadcast.

methods.name: sessionBlockIds
methods.description: Returns all block IDs associated with a specific session UUID.

methods.name: removeBlock
methods.description: Removes a block and releases its write lock.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all tracked block metadata and resets the manager.
